source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 17 May 1961, p. 5 ("County and rural council nominations")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish News Archive)
source.check: Cloughogue return read in the News-Letter nomination report of 17 May 1961; all other divisions from the Ballymena Weekly Telegraph (18 May 1961, p. 4).

note: Triennial election of Ballymena Rural District Council, polled Thursday 1 June 1961. There was no contest: all the sitting members were returned except in Cloughogue, where Mr. Oliver Given succeeded the retiring Mr. George C. Nelson. Only the Cloughogue return is named in the report read. Given succeeded Mr. George C. Nelson, who did not seek re-election. Returned unopposed.
